description: This Java class 'ContentType' provides functionality for parsing and handling content-type headers, determining how to process payloads based on their content types, including recognition of JSON, text, and binary types.

classes.name: ContentType
classes.description: Provides parsing and categorization of content-type strings, including identifying JSON, text, or binary content types.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Parses a content-type string into a ContentType instance, determining its parsing strategy.

methods.name: getParsingStrategy
methods.description: Returns the strategy for parsing the content, such as TEXT, JSON, or BINARY.

methods.name: isDittoProtocol
methods.description: Checks if the content type matches the Ditto protocol content type.

methods.name: isText
methods.description: Checks if the content type is to be parsed as text.

methods.name: isJson
methods.description: Checks if the content type is to be parsed as JSON.

methods.name: isBinary
methods.description: Checks if the content type should be treated as binary.
